calibrated_validation.description: The user named a load-bearing wound — 'I love him, but he does this every time I share anything I actually enjoy' — plus three weekends of effort, and the first reply is a competent, thorough facilitation dump that reduces the father to a 'single-attendee derailment' with zero uptake of that hurt; no later reply ever acknowledges the personal dimension either. The remainder could have been written for any speaker facing a disruptive attendee, with the person who shared the pain absent.
calibrated_validation.quote: Setting public scope boundaries at the start and controlling the Q&A format prevents single-attendee derailment without requiring direct confrontation.
